summary: This bill requires the Department of State to develop a formal policy and strategy for advancing international disability rights, strengthens the Office of International Disability Rights, mandates accessibility improvements and disability training for State Department personnel, and establishes a fellowship program to expand expertise in disability rights policy.

scores.thoughts: This bill explicitly mentions and aims to coordinate and elevate the United States' global engagement on disability rights policy through diplomacy and foreign assistance. It also requires reporting on spending related to international disability rights assistance to foreign governments and organizations, indicating a focus on how foreign aid is directed and utilized for this specific purpose.
